posts.title: TUI Vibe Coding Frenzy
posts.description: I recently got myself an OpenCode Go subscription to play with. It’s reasonably cheap and comes with “generous limits”, which I can confirm because I had DeepSeek v4.1 Flash spurt out code basically non-stop for ~three weeks now and the OpenCode console says that as of now I’ve only used 35% of my monthly tokens.

posts.title: Stealth Camping w/ Overpass Turbo
posts.description: Lately I’ve been watching some people on YouTube pursue a hobby they call stealth camping. It’s basically wild camping but usually in a more urban setting where camping isn’t allowed so the campers gotta find hidden spots or come up with some kind of clever camouflage or contraptions to conceal their camp.
